files.title: A new inquiry, not an erased failure

Disable the revealed Medusa with EMP after overcoming its shields by your chosen weapons/EMP. Activate the qualified Salvage Beam; physically recover its original 50 kg reconstruction lattice with the automatic salvage laser and Fuel Scoops.
At Ranenor, align the two orbital lanterns from the marked observation waypoint. Confirm each alignment when its reflected trace meets the inward mark.
Take the complete clue collection to the AI at any PLUGH station and choose Decode the collected traces.
Return to any PLUGH station with the same intact reconstruction lattice. Authorise its actual receiving and ask the AI to reconstruct the Medusa.
Reach the marked outer-cradle waypoint at Ashor and transmit the complete decoded pattern.
At Berilir, scan three marked echoes along the asteroid ring to complete the listener's pattern.
At Corur, scan the dormant listener above the planet's dark hemisphere.
